messages:
maya: Quick sync — finalizing runtime+infra signals for the new Inference Overview dashboard. Need final decisions on alert thresholds and PagerDuty routing before dashboard PR. Who owns the pages vs warnings? @sre-oncall

samir: I can take runtime metrics. Draft alerts: sustained p95/p99 latency, model_fallback_rate, kv_cache_hit_rate drops, token_throughput regressions, and request_rejects. Want tiered severities (warn -> page).

violet: Product telemetry preference: SLO-first. Propose SLOs: p95 latency <200ms, combined error (5xx + fallback) <0.5% over 1h. Page if burn_rate >4 over 10m.

lee-infra: Agree. Add infra signals: queue_length_per_shard >100, gpu_utilization <10% (possible preempt), scheduler_retries_rate >0.1%.

sre-oncall: Paging rules draft: SLO violation with burn_rate>=4 for 10m -> page inference-prod PD. burn_rate 1.5-4 -> alert to Slack and create ticket; no page unless escalated.

maya: We should be able to validate routing without waking folks — add a staging PD test label (severity=test) so alerts can fire to PD staging. Can we have a simulated window?

samir: Yes, metrics team has PD staging. Example alert (p99) will include a test alert label for staging. Example (will tune token-normalized soon):

```yaml
alert: InferenceP99High
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, region)) > 0.45
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
  team: runtime
annotations:
  summary: "Inference p99 high (model={{ $labels.model }}, region={{ $labels.region }})"
  runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-p99"
```

violet: Two things: 1) Prefer latency_per_token normalization for mixed-length workloads. 2) Add model and region labels for routing to regional oncall.

lee-infra: Region labels make sense. For infra alerts route to infra-prod PD first; only escalate into inference-prod if runtime also flags an issue. Prevents noisy cross-team pages.

sre-oncall: Routing matrix (working draft):
- severity:page + team:runtime -> inference-prod PD
- severity:page + team:infra -> infra-prod PD
- severity:page + label regional=true -> regional PD (if configured) else inference-prod
- severity:warning -> Slack (#eng-sre) + ticket if >1h

maya: Dashboard UX: each panel should show SLO, burn-rate sparkline, runbook link. Also a quick-action: "open rollback" that launches a runbook-led rollback flow (product request).

samir: Also add a canary synthetic every 30s per region+model. If canary fails 3x -> SEV1 page. Canary pages should go to oncall and notify product-telemetry.

violet: Noise reduction: suppress latency pages during coordinated deploys (deploy-bot label deploy=true). Keep error pages active. Also group alerts by model/version to reduce duplicates.

maya: Thresholds draft (starting points):
- p95 warning: 150ms; p95 page: >300ms sustained 10m
- p99 page: >600ms 10m
- Error (5xx + fallback) page: >0.5% over 10m
- KV cache hit drop: >20% relative drop vs baseline over 30m
- Queue length per shard page: >100 for 5m
- SLO burn rate page: >4 over 10m

lee-infra: Fine as baseline. Tune after 2 weeks.

samir: Implementation note: annotate metrics with {team=\"runtime\", service=\"inference\", model=..., region=...} so Alertmanager routes cleanly and console filters work.

sre-oncall: PagerDuty escalation plan: primary 15m -> secondary 15m -> manager. When autoscale or automated mitigation runs, have Alertmanager webhook acknowledge PD incident.

violet: Console UX asks: 1) show burn-rate sparkline on panel header, 2) toggle normalized per-1k tokens, 3) quick action button to start rollback runbook.

maya: Action items: Samir+Lee — make Alertmanager YAML PR and Grafana dashboard JSON. Include runbook links and PD service IDs. Add a test alert to PD staging.

samir: Will open infra/monitoring PRs. Will include staging test alert and example playbook.

lee-infra: I'll draft deploy suppression rules and infra->inference escalation hooks.

sre-oncall: Add me as reviewer and attach oncall test procedure. We'll dry-run routing.

oncall-bot: [automated] Created PD staging test incident: INC-staging-2026-03-18-001. Test runbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/oncall-tests

maya: Timeline: dashboard PR by EOD Wed, alerts PR Thu AM, dry-run Fri 10-11am. Speak up if you can't meet.

samir: OK on those dates.

lee-infra: OK Thu morning.

violet: I'll validate telemetry labels Thu.

sre-oncall: I'll schedule the dry-run and block the time.

maya: Also add a short README in the dashboard folder covering expected tuning cadence (2 weeks) and where to request changes (#eng-observability).
